identity.description: A malicious process renames itself to crond and executes from a non-standard location, attempting to blend in with legitimate system processes. Cortex should detect this masquerading behavior and flag the process start event.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Masquerading as crond process
biocs.description: Process starts with name 'crond' but from non-standard path
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'crond'
| filter action_file_path != '/usr/sbin/crond' and action_file_path != '/sbin/crond'
| filter action_file_path != '/bin/crond'

abiocs.name: Masquerading as Linux crond process
abiocs.description: Detects process masquerading as crond from non-standard path using behavioral ML
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'crond'
| filter action_file_path != '/usr/sbin/crond' and action_file_path != '/sbin/crond'
| filter action_file_path != '/bin/crond'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'init'

xql_queries.name: Detect crond masquerading
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'crond'
| filter action_file_path != '/usr/sbin/crond' and action_file_path != '/sbin/crond'
| filter action_file_path != '/bin/crond'
| fields agent_hostname, action_file_path, actor_process_image_name
